sources.primary_title: iQIBLA to Make a Debut at LEAP 2026, Unveiling New Product Strategy and Innovations Across Three Major Product Lines
sources.verified_angle_summary: Muslim-first tech brand iQIBLA announced its debut at the LEAP 2026 Tech Expo in Riyadh, unveiling a comprehensive new ecosystem strategy and three major product lines. The brand is expanding beyond its signature smart prayer rings to introduce the Zikr Ring R1 and the diamond-set Aura series. In a significant move into health and family technology, iQIBLA launched the Hajj Band—a smart wristband designed to monitor pilgrims' health and safety during Hajj and Umrah—alongside a blood pressure smartwatch tailored for Muslim users. Additionally, the company introduced the Qimi AI product line, featuring the QIMI Phone, billed as the world's first smartphone for Muslim children, and the QIMI Watch K2s. This distinct hardware angle highlights the intersection of religious practice and modern consumer electronics, offering a concrete product launch story that avoids general event overviews or infrastructure announcements.
